row.notes: myteam-g1: Large per-day tick of the My Team driver contracts component: walks the 0x68-byte slots (state +0x4e4/+0x4e5, driver key +0x4dc), checks calendar days, runs AI approach and meeting scheduling (FUN_140db7e30/db7660/db90d0), updates days-to-decision (+0x4c8), posts bus messages and fires my_team_contract_window_opened. Central logic for contract talk timing.
